description: Gujarat Govt signs ₹100 crore MoU with Automation Anywhere for AI training, skill development and emerging technology capacity building.
body_lead: Gandhinagar: The Gujarat Government’s Department of Science and Technology has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Automation Anywhere, a global company specialising in Artificial Intelligence (AI), Agentic Automation, Intelligent Automation and Robotic Process Automation (RPA). The partnership aims to strengthen Gujarat’s AI ecosystem by promoting AI awareness, youth training, capacity building and collaboration between the government, industry and academic institutions.
